## Overview

This document tests the **stacking selection module** using a fully simulated
dataset. Each section is an independent node.

The simulated GEBV matrix represents:
- **12 haplotype blocks**
- **15 founder samples**
- One trait with positive/negative block effects

---

## 1  Simulate GEBV Matrix

```{r sim-gebv}
library(haploStack)
library(data.table)

set.seed(42)
N_BLOCKS  <- 12L
N_SAMPLES <- 15L

## Create a random Block × Sample GEBV matrix
## Positive values = beneficial haplotype at that block
raw_mat <- matrix(
  stats::rnorm(N_BLOCKS * N_SAMPLES, mean = 0, sd = 1),
  nrow = N_BLOCKS
)
colnames(raw_mat) <- paste0("S", seq_len(N_SAMPLES))

gebv_mat <- as.data.table(raw_mat)
gebv_mat[, Block := paste0("Chr1_B", seq_len(N_BLOCKS))]
setcolorder(gebv_mat, c("Block", paste0("S", seq_len(N_SAMPLES))))

cat("GEBV matrix dimensions:", dim(gebv_mat), "\n")
cat("Block × Sample matrix (first 4 blocks, 6 samples):\n")
print(gebv_mat[1:4, 1:7, with = FALSE])
```

---

## 2  Make Cross Design  [Node: `make_cross_design`]

```{r cross-design}
## ── Node: make_cross_design ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Select 6 parents for crossing

parents_6 <- paste0("S", 1:6)

## 2a — all pairwise
design_all <- make_cross_design(parents_6, method = "all_pairs",
                                 n_offspring = 4L)
cat("All-pairs design: ", nrow(design_all), "crosses\n")
print(design_all)

## 2b — sequential
design_seq <- make_cross_design(parents_6, method = "sequential",
                                 n_offspring = 2L)
cat("\nSequential design: ", nrow(design_seq), "crosses\n")
print(design_seq)
```

---

## 3  Greedy Selection  [Node: `greedy_selection`]

```{r greedy}
## ── Node: greedy_selection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Select 6 parents from 15 candidates by block coverage

selected_greedy <- greedy_selection(gebv_mat, n_parents = 6L, min_effect = 0.1)
cat("Greedy selected parents:", selected_greedy, "\n")

## Coverage statistics
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(gebv_mat), "Block")
all_coverage <- sapply(sample_cols, function(s)
  sum(gebv_mat[[s]] > 0.1) / N_BLOCKS)
sel_coverage <- sapply(selected_greedy, function(s)
  sum(gebv_mat[[s]] > 0.1) / N_BLOCKS)

cat("Mean individual coverage (all):", round(mean(all_coverage), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean individual coverage (selected):", round(mean(sel_coverage), 3), "\n")

## Block coverage of the selected set
covered <- apply(
  as.matrix(gebv_mat[, selected_greedy, with = FALSE]) > 0.1,
  1, any
)
cat("Proportion of blocks covered by selection:", round(mean(covered), 3), "\n")
```

---

## 4  Genetic Algorithm Selection  [Node: `genetic_algorithm_selection`]

```{r ga-selection}
## ── Node: genetic_algorithm_selection ──────────────────────────────────────────

selected_ga <- genetic_algorithm_selection(
  gebv_mat,
  n_parents     = 6L,
  n_generations = 100L,
  seed          = 42L,
  verbose       = FALSE
)
cat("GA selected parents:", selected_ga, "\n")

## Compare coverage: greedy vs GA
covered_ga <- apply(
  as.matrix(gebv_mat[, selected_ga, with = FALSE]) > 0.1,
  1, any
)
cat("GA block coverage:", round(mean(covered_ga), 3), "\n")
cat("Greedy block coverage:", round(mean(covered), 3), "\n")
```

### 4.1 Reproducibility check

```{r ga-repro}
ga_r1 <- genetic_algorithm_selection(gebv_mat, n_parents = 4L,
                                      n_generations = 50L, seed = 7L)
ga_r2 <- genetic_algorithm_selection(gebv_mat, n_parents = 4L,
                                      n_generations = 50L, seed = 7L)
cat("Same seed → identical result:", identical(ga_r1, ga_r2), "\n")
```

---

## 5  OCS Selection  [Node: `ocs_selection`]

> `ocs_selection()` is kept for compatibility but **has known issues** (it is a
> kinship-penalised truncation, not optimum-contribution selection, and falls
> back to plain truncation when the kinship cap stops it early). For simulations
> use `TS`, `OHS` or `GBS` in `run_stacking_simulation()`; see
> `vignettes/selection_grid.md`. Without a kinship matrix, as below, it is plain
> truncation on total GEBV.

```{r ocs}
## ── Node: ocs_selection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Using total GEBV (column sums) as breeding value

total_gebv <- setNames(
  colSums(as.matrix(gebv_mat[, sample_cols, with = FALSE])),
  sample_cols
)
cat("Total GEBV range:", round(range(total_gebv), 3), "\n")

## Pure truncation (no kinship)
selected_ocs <- ocs_selection(total_gebv, n_parents = 6L)
cat("OCS (no kinship) selected:", selected_ocs, "\n")

## Compare to sorted GEBV ranking
top_gebv <- names(sort(total_gebv, decreasing = TRUE))[1:6]
cat("Pure GEBV top-6:", top_gebv, "\n")
cat("Match:", all(sort(selected_ocs) == sort(top_gebv)), "\n")
```

---

## 6  Compare Selection Methods

```{r compare-methods}
## ── Compare: Greedy vs GA vs OCS ──────────────────────────────────────────────

methods_list <- list(
  Greedy = selected_greedy,
  GA     = selected_ga,
  OCS    = selected_ocs
)

comparison <- lapply(names(methods_list), function(method) {
  sel  <- methods_list[[method]]
  cov  <- mean(apply(as.matrix(gebv_mat[, sel, with = FALSE]) > 0.1,
                     1, any))
  gval <- mean(total_gebv[sel])
  data.table(Method = method, BlockCoverage = cov,
             MeanGEBV = round(gval, 4))
})

comp_dt <- rbindlist(comparison)
cat("Selection method comparison:\n")
print(comp_dt)
```

---

## 7  Summarise Simulation Output  [Node: `summarise_simulation`]

```{r simulate-trajectories}
## ── Simulate fake trajectory data for summarise_simulation testing ─────────────
set.seed(99L)
fake_traj <- rbindlist(lapply(1:3, function(rep) {
  cycles <- 1:10
  data.table(
    Rep           = rep,
    Cycle         = cycles,
    Method        = "GA",
    MeanGEBV      = cumsum(runif(10L, 0, 0.1)),
    SDev          = abs(rnorm(10L, 0.05, 0.01)),
    BlockCoverage = pmin(1, 0.4 + cumsum(runif(10L, 0, 0.06)))
  )
}))

sim_summary <- summarise_simulation(fake_traj, group_by = c("Cycle","Method"))
cat("Simulation summary (first 5 cycles):\n")
print(sim_summary[1:5])
```

### 7.1  Trajectory plot

```{r plot-traj, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
p_traj <- plot_simulation_trajectories(
  fake_traj,
  trait_name    = "Simulated Trait",
  show_ribbon   = TRUE,
  show_coverage = FALSE
)
print(p_traj)
```
